description: This file defines the SmsWritePlatformService interface, which declares methods for creating, updating, and deleting SMS resources within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: SmsWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface specifying methods for SMS resource management in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SMS resource based on the provided command.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing SMS resource identified by resourceId with data from the command.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an SMS resource identified by resourceId.
